description.value: The standard issue M18A1 Claymore fires steel balls in a 10m cone when remote activated, dealing 8d6 damage (DC 15 reflex for half). Alternatively, a character who is proficient with explosives can set a trip-wire. The wire can typically span a 10m line and requires a DC 15 Perception check to spot before triggering. Other Claymore mines exist, produced by other Tau’ri military as well as alien cultures who produce similar devices.
